example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটাই আপনভোলা যে বগলে পুঁথি ঘরময় খোঁজা করে।
এই ঢিলেঢালা লোকটার জন্য বগলে পুঁথি ঘরময় খোঁজা হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He is so forgetful that he searches the house for a book tucked under his arm.
That careless fellow ended up searching the entire house for the book under his armpit.
note: The idiom humorously depicts everyday forgetfulness in Bengali rural or semi-urban life.
